# Brightdesk

> Brightdesk is a shared inbox and help desk for small support teams. Plans start at $19 per agent per month.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://www.brightdesk.example/pricing): plans, prices, and what each plan includes
- [Customer stories](https://www.brightdesk.example/customers): how small teams use Brightdesk

## Help center

- [Getting started](https://www.brightdesk.example/docs/getting-started): connect your support email and invite your team
- [Automations](https://www.brightdesk.example/docs/automations): tag, assign, and close conversations with rules
